name: Hingham Shipyard
summary: Hingham Shipyard is an upscale waterfront lifestyle center in Hingham, MA, featuring fitness, wellness, dining, and entertainment options including Club Pilates, Sweathouz, and Patriot Cinemas. This open-air destination offers a sophisticated harborside experience on Boston's South Shore.
demographics: Hingham Shipyard attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from the South Shore of Massachusetts, with visitors typically in the 30-65 age range and above-average household incomes. The trade area draws from Hingham and surrounding coastal communities known for their high property values and educated professional population. Shoppers here seek a mix of fitness, wellness, dining, and entertainment options in an upscale waterfront setting, with strong preferences for experiential retail and lifestyle amenities over traditional shopping.
description: Hingham Shipyard is a premier waterfront lifestyle destination located along the scenic harbor of Hingham, Massachusetts. This open-air shopping and entertainment center offers a unique blend of fitness, wellness, dining, and entertainment experiences in a beautifully designed harborside setting. The center features notable tenants including Club Pilates for boutique fitness enthusiasts, Sweathouz for innovative wellness experiences, and Patriot Cinemas for entertainment. With its picturesque location at Shipyard Drive, the development provides visitors with a sophisticated atmosphere that combines the charm of coastal New England with modern lifestyle amenities. The center's focus on experiential retail and community gathering spaces makes it a distinctive destination on Boston's South Shore, offering both residents and visitors a compelling alternative to traditional shopping centers.
